card.name: Scattered small words in general web text
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (like 'm, of, him, this, and, a comma or dash) in ordinary web prose, mostly teaching or grammar text. No shared trigger is clear.
card.plain: It fires on assorted small words in everyday web writing, with no pattern a clinician could use.
